report:
Reassessed the complete current claim and association set against the supplied prior independent review. Independently verified exact byte equality of current src/inspector.rs and service_spec.rs with the historical source snapshots; no source deltas require a changed conclusion. Freshly inspected the current claim, sole ordinary implementation association, sole TODO test body, and index construction helpers captured in the implementation whole-file fragment.
Requirements are (1) one complete local detail-free index, (2) browser filtering of that directory without transmitting search text or fetching branches, (3) exclusion of dependency symbols, and (4) permitting external macro-expansion facts while forbidding broader semantic metadata and item details. indexed_symbols creates the local crate root and recursively walks expanded ownership; owned_symbol_children handles modules, enum variants and local trait/impl associated items. build_symbol_directory returns all collected summaries in one index. walk_symbols builds search_text, paths and presentation; canonical_children rejects external symbols through is_external. Child completeness records macro expansion incompleteness explicitly; this is not evidence that all macro expansions are always complete. The visible construction path does not directly request signature/body/product details. These source facts support the intended directory structure, but do not establish the complete transitive query budget or browser network behavior.
The entire associated test set is sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_detail_free_index. It contains no assertions and is correctly classified TODO, not ordinary coverage. Its explicit prerequisite is association and review of complete real-workspace trace evidence with a closed operation-family set, allowing macro metadata families and forbidding signatures, bodies, associated values and impl discovery. I accept that pending cross-layer evidence prerequisite as the prior review did: completeness, client-only filtering/no branch requests, dependency exclusion and transitive detail-free construction still lack ordinary associated behavioral coverage. In particular, a regression introducing a forbidden query or network search would not be caught by this placeholder. The approval accepts this visible deferral, not an implemented/tested guarantee; no N/A entries exist. No additional runtime helper source is used to assert the deferred transitive guarantee. Captured the review decisions policy supporting this accounting.
Executed review start/read and exact source comparison, followed by review record; no behavior tests or builds were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported build and 321-test pass are separate historical execution and are not used as proof of this claim. No edits are requested to the existing explicit TODO accounting.
